ns2:course.label: Cooperative Education Practice
ns2:course.description: (CHEM 202) Off-campus cooperative practice of chemistry or chemical engineering in industrial or governmental facilities. Each chemistry or chemical engineering student participating in cooperative education must register for CHEM 293 for each off-campus term. Same as CHBE 202. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Acceptance into the School of Chemical Sciences Cooperative Education Program.
